name: Buzzbar – Announcement Bar, Promo Bar & Notification Banner
author: Blend Media

sections.description:
🚀 Supercharged Notification Bars for WordPress
Buzzbar makes it easy to add eye-catching announcement bars to your website that actually get clicks.
Whether you’re promoting a sale, highlighting an offer, or guiding users to take action—Buzzbar helps you do it fast.

🔥 Core Features

  • Add a top announcement bar in seconds
  • Custom text, colors, and CTA button
  • Mobile responsive and lightweight
  • Show across your entire site or selected pages
  • Simple display controls (delay, close button, etc.)

⚡ Pro Features (Upgrade Anytime)

  • Rotating announcement bars (multiple messages)
  • Scrolling ticker / marquee (news-style)
  • WooCommerce targeting (cart value, products, categories)
  • Advanced targeting (device, referrer, UTM tracking)
  • Animations and attention effects
  • Scheduling (start/end dates for promos)
  • Click & impression tracking

💰 Built for Conversions

Buzzbar isn’t just a banner—it’s a conversion tool.
Use it to:

  • Promote offers and discounts
  • Increase clicks to key pages
  • Highlight free shipping or deals
  • Capture attention instantly

🧩 Works Great With

  • WooCommerce
  • Any WordPress theme
  • Page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, and more

⚙️ Easy Setup

Install, activate, and launch your first announcement bar in minutes—no tech skills needed.

🔗 Want More Power?

Buzzbar Pro coming soon!
sections.faq:
Can I display the banner at the bottom?

Yes. Select “Bottom” from the Position tab.

How do I make the banner visible?

Set the status to “Live”.

How do I dismiss the banner?

Click the close (×) button on the banner. It will stay hidden for 7 days via a browser cookie.

Is this plugin secure?

The plugin includes nonce verification, capability checks, sanitization, and escaping.
